run_all_evaluations: run all_evaluations on a hypernymy model to get a unified nested dictionary of all benchmark results
create_dataset: create a Dataset object from a TSV file with a model vocabulary dictionary for hypernymy evaluation
run_correlation_setup: run correlation_setup to compute Spearman rho between model predictions and continuous scores on a dataset
run_siege_setup: run siege_setup to compute average precision scores for a binary hypernymy dataset
run_bless_directionality: run bless_directionality_setup to test if a model predicts correct directionality for positive hypernymy pairs
